summary: Server list of action-resource amounts that come back after a cooldown (6 seconds real time, or turn-based ticks in FTB), kept by esv::action_resource::CooldownSystem. LEGACY_RequestTrackCooldown(entity, Guid resource, double amount, int) queues a 32-byte request per entity; StartRequestedCooldowns (bg3.exe+0x32909E0, named) creates the component if needed and appends one 40-byte entry per request with timer 6.0; TickRealtimeCooldowns subtracts the frame time from the timer. Saved as model game.action_resources.v0.CooldownTrackingComponent (16 bytes) with elements game.action_resources.v0.CooldownTrackingData (32 bytes); member names not known. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

fields.name: Resource
fields.evidence: StartRequestedCooldowns copies the request's first 16 bytes; the request is built by Toolkit LEGACY_RequestTrackCooldown (EoCServer.dll+0x1610A90) from its `Guid const &` parameter (the action resource definition).

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: LEGACY_RequestTrackCooldown stores its `double` parameter at request +0x10 (`puVar7[2] = param_3`); StartRequestedCooldowns copies request qword +0x10 to entry +0x10.

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: LEGACY_RequestTrackCooldown stores its `int` parameter at request +0x18; copied to entry +0x18. macOS Save reads 4 bytes at entry +0x18 (resource level or index; meaning not established).

fields.name: _Pad1C
fields.evidence: request padding copied with the 32-byte block; not saved.

fields.name: TimeLeft
fields.evidence: StartRequestedCooldowns writes 0x40c00000 (6.0f) at entry +0x20; Toolkit TickRealtimeCooldowns (EoCServer.dll+0x1611CB0) does `*(float*)(e+0x20) -= *(float*)(gameTime+8)` with stride 0x28.

fields.name: Cooldowns
fields.evidence: StartRequestedCooldowns (bg3.exe+0x32909E0) allocates the component with AllocRaw 0x10 and zeroes +0/+8/+0xC (Toolkit ctor EoCServer.dll+0x262400 does the same), grows it (FUN_1406de630) and writes element `lVar17 + i*0x28`; destructor bg3.exe+0x686280 frees the buffer at +0.
